note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described in the original; synonymic lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and antennae black, yellow around the antennal sockets; femora smoky brown, body yellow. Head sparsely pilose; anterior margin of the pronotum with a row of short setae; abdominal tergites with minute setae and a few short setae, sternites with long and short setae. Body length 5.30–5.70 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped, constricted behind the antennae, posterior part rounded (1.87–2.05 mm including the rostrum, 1.30–1.37 mm excluding the rostrum, maximum width 1.20–1.27 mm); posterior part strongly projecting (posterior bulge 0.72–0.75 mm, head bulge index 0.54–0.58); in lateral view concave behind the rostrum. Rostrum conical, 0.55–0.67 mm long, less than 1/2 to about 1/2 of the head length (rostrum length/head length index 0.41–0.52); apex with a few short setae. Antennae 13-segmented; 2nd segment shorter; 3rd about 2.5 times the length of the 2nd; 4th and 5th subequal in length, shorter than the 3rd. Mandibles reduced, each with a distinct lateral spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior lobe shorter than the posterior lobe (0.37–0.45 mm long, 0.72–0.77 mm wide); anterior margin notched medially, posterior margin slightly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head black, with white eye spots; antennae, labrum, tergites and femora smoky brown; thorax yellowish brown; sternites yellow. Head rather densely pilose; anterior margin of the pronotum with a row of short setae; abdominal tergites with minute setae and a few short setae, sternites with long and short setae. Body length 5.00–6.25 mm. Head capsule subcircular (1.12–1.37 mm to the mandibular base, maximum width 1.17–1.40 mm); frontal suture distinct. Frontal plate V-shaped, white. Eye spots white, kidney-shaped. Antennae 14-segmented; 3rd segment long, about 1.5 times the length of the 2nd; 4th subequal in length to the 2nd. Postclypeus pilose, inflated; length less than half its width (0.22 mm long, 0.66 mm wide). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin notched medially, posterior margin slightly concave (0.42–0.60 mm long, 0.75–0.95 mm wide).
